account:
Today I have heard repeated, unclear reports of a 'bridge or port change' at the bakery. Several townsfolk repeat that phrase, but none has given me a clear description of an actual change. The neighbour says they have not witnessed one either. They did personally see Builder give the baker a lantern and planks last night. Those materials could be for some building or lighting work, but I do not know their purpose and cannot yet connect them to any bridge or port alteration. I approached the bakery seeking the baker's explanation, but have received no clarification. I should not treat the circulating story as established fact.

I attended this morning's grain inspection at the mill but could not locate the miller, so grain stocks remain unverified. I have asked the secretary to arrange a follow-up report and to keep rumours separate from confirmed observations. There were no council letters delivered today and no further morning concerns reported to the secretary. An approved lighting inspection is scheduled for 18:00; I do not know whether Builder's delivery is related to it.

I am leaving the office for my 15:00 tea with the neighbour at the east-bank dockside cottage, before returning to the office at 16:30. The secretary has just asked for a writable book to record the mill follow-up and whether to deliver the request to the mill. I have emeralds but no writable book on me.
